items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: church there at Lapeyrouse [Street] and St. Bernard Avenue

ctx.x: They want to swing. They go . . . They’re swinging everywhere, like I told you. I gave you the description of the send off. He going to glory. Let him go. After that, let’s kick him up. They have been pleasant. They have been sweet and nice and going about their business with the family. After the family’s gone . . . The family knows what’s going to happen, but you respect the family. But [Harold] Dejan[’s band] have a tendency today that they’ll even hit that when the family’s there. They take too much liberty.…
St. Bernard and [North] Derbigny [Street]. You know that church there?
